> ⚠️ **WARNING — DO NOT disclose vulnerability details publicly.**
>
> This issue template is visible to everyone. If you believe you have found a
> security vulnerability, **do not** describe the exploit, affected secrets,
> or reproduction steps in a public issue.
>
> Please follow [SECURITY.md](../../SECURITY.md):
>
> 1. Report privately via GitHub **private vulnerability reporting** (Security
>    tab → **Report a vulnerability**), or
> 2. Use the security contact listed in [SECURITY.md](../../SECURITY.md).
>
> Public issues describing vulnerabilities will be closed without discussion
> and the reporter will be directed to the private channel.

If you are not sure whether the issue is security-related, err on the side of
reporting privately.

Use this public template only for **non-sensitive** security discussion (for
example, asking about hardening best practices or planned security work)
**without** including vulnerability details.
